name: mudlet-toolbox
description: Build, debug, and validate Mudlet packages, Lua scripts, interfaces, protocols, and maps.

interface.longDescription: Six focused skills for Mudlet package development, Lua scripting, events and protocols, Geyser interfaces, mapping, and package testing, aligned with official Mudlet best practices. Includes a Muddler starter, Lua examples, and a read-only package inspector.
defaultPrompt: Create a Mudlet package with an alias and clean lifecycle.
Build a Geyser interface for my game's status data.
Check a Mudlet package for installation and cleanup issues.
Review my Mudlet extension against official best practices.
